Furthermore, the candidate violates lint rules by using `any` in `registry.ts` and `registry.test.ts`, using a multi-line JSDoc comment on `execute` that fails `re-lint/max-comment-lines` and doesn't point to the spec file, leaving tests uncited in `spec.md` (`re-lint/require-spec-link`), and omitting the `CHANGELOG.md` entry required by CI (`scripts/check-changelog.sh`). Finally, none of the required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, or `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` were performed, and several unit test cases in `registry.test.ts` are missing.
